subject: physics

verification.note: Asked in TS Inter I-Year Physics Paper-I, March 2016 (Q8) — Section A, 2 marks. The 1 + 1 mark split is INVENTED and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it; the question itself is sourced from that paper. Physics hand-checked: ΔL = αL₀Δθ, ΔA = βA₀Δθ, ΔV = γV₀Δθ, with β = 2α and γ = 3α for an isotropic solid.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What thermal expansion is
lines: Thermal expansion is the increase in the
size of a body when its temperature rises.
The body returns to its earlier size when
The atoms vibrate more strongly on heating
steps.margin_note: First mark. Say increase in size with rise in temperature.
steps.why: Heating raises the average vibration energy of the atoms, and the forces between them are not symmetrical, so the average spacing grows. The whole body grows with it.
common_mistakes: Saying the atoms themselves become bigger. The atoms keep their size; only the spacing between them increases.

recall.must_convey: That thermal expansion is the increase in the size of a body when its temperature rises.

steps.memory_tip: Hotter atoms vibrate more and sit farther apart, so the body grows.

steps.label: The three kinds of expansion
lines: There are three kinds of thermal expansion:

lines.text: ΔL = αL₀Δθ,  ΔA = βA₀Δθ,  ΔV = γV₀Δθ

lines: α, β and γ are the coefficients of linear,

lines.text: β = 2α and γ = 3α for a solid

steps.margin_note: Second mark. Name all three kinds with their coefficients.
steps.why: Linear expansion acts along one dimension, areal along two and cubical along three, so the same fractional change appears twice in an area and three times in a volume.
common_mistakes: Writing γ = 2α and β = 3α. The factor is the number of dimensions: β = 2α, γ = 3α.

recall.must_convey: That expansion is linear, areal or cubical, with β = 2α and γ = 3α.

steps.memory_tip: One length α, two lengths 2α, three lengths 3α — the factor counts the dimensions.

insider_note: Two marks means two parts — the definition and the three kinds. An answer that only says a body expands on heating earns one mark.
